PhysVal-07 reviewed **`aa9b0e717efc831bd858180a88ad1d4dba77eeed`**, read-only. **No remaining material scientific or evidence findings within the declared prototype scope.**

Actual checks:

- All **77** committed study source/evidence/figure files matched the pinned revision.
- All **16** native reports and full event arrays matched retained SHA-256 bindings.
- Original point/source audit passed **76,032 statistics**, fractions, paired differences and **24 service cases**.
- Full Gaussian **400-draw bootstrap replay passed**.
- A separate implementation reproduced central Gaussian ratios and bootstrap errors.
- Deterministic report replay passed; Gaussian/native ratio and absolute-width figures were visually inspected.
- The unchanged original full-bootstrap verification record was inspected; that costly replay was not repeated.

The evidence distinguishes the responses correctly. At 100 GeV, |η|<1:

| Pitch | Gaussian z₀ ratio | Gaussian θ ratio |
|---|---:|---:|
| 1 mm | 1.106 ± 0.019 | 1.159 ± 0.023 |
| 1.5 mm | 1.117 ± 0.022 | 1.216 ± 0.028 |
| 2 mm | 1.132 ± 0.024 | 1.229 ± 0.031 |

The native geometric core narrowing remains documented alongside weaker SD changes, non-closing pulls and verified covariance coupling. The Gaussian comparison demonstrates overall response dependence; it does not isolate the complete mechanism or establish calibrated detector performance.

All five missing 1 GeV digital fits are the same events across pitches and have fewer than seven primary measurements. Higher-momentum fits are complete. Wrong-charge events remain included, with identical masks across pitches. Gaussian edge retries, momentum-pull nonclosure, fixed material and conditional power/harness assumptions are explicitly qualified.

This supports the requested repeatable sensitivity study and conditional engineering estimates. It does **not** select a preferred pitch or grant detector design acceptance. No files changed or native runs executed during this final review.
